name: Org invitations v2 — approval frames
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for FuzeFront's organization invitations v2 (Jira FFRNT-306, epic FFRNT-304). Covers three flows: (1) the Members-tab invite modal choosing invitee kind {existing|external}, channel {email|WhatsApp e164}, role {admin|member|viewer} and member type {employee|customer} plus the pending-invitations list (resend/revoke); (2) accept -> sign up (incl. Google/Facebook) -> auto-bind for a brand-new external invitee, showing org + role + member type; (3) the root-org owner inviting an external person (Gmail/WhatsApp) as a customer. States are contract: loading/empty/error and the fail-closed cases (410 expired/revoked, 403 identity mismatch, 409 already-accepted, 409 last-owner, 403 forbidden). Approving a flow approves its visual + interaction model AND its slice of the component/package/contract build inventory before UI implementation. Invitations have NO OpenAPI contract today (v1 is un-contracted Express) so the endpoints here are commissioned for contract-designer to freeze. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against these via the data-frame / data-* hooks.

commissionedByApproval: ENTIRE invitation contract is net-new: packages/security/openapi.yaml has ZERO invitation endpoints today. v1 is un-contracted hand-rolled Express (backend/src/routes/invitations.ts, backend/src/routes/organizations.ts). contract-designer must freeze all six endpoints above + their schemas into the Security OpenAPI and regenerate @fuzefront/security-client.

InvitationCreate = { inviteeKind: existing|external, channel: email|whatsapp, address (email string OR e164 phone), role: admin|member|viewer, memberType: employee|customer }. The owning service mints the invitation id + token (never client-supplied); additionalProperties:false (identifier-standard).

MemberType {employee|customer} is NET-NEW. Today the employee/customer distinction is structural (derived ReBAC staff vs. a direct membership row) with no member_type field anywhere. v2 makes it an explicit, persisted field on the invitation and resulting membership.

InviteChannel {email|whatsapp}: email delivery reuses services/email-service org-invite template (ZeptoMail). WhatsApp is NET-NEW — services/sms-service is Twilio SMS-only today (channel hard-coded 'sms'); a WhatsApp sender (and e164 validation) must be built. Delegate the Twilio WhatsApp integration to telephony-integrator.

GET /v1/security/invitations/resolve?token= is PUBLIC (unauthenticated) and returns a masked InvitationPreview { orgName, role, memberType, channel, maskedAddress, expiresAt }. 410 when expired/revoked, 409 when already accepted. Token is opaque; resolving must not be an enumeration oracle.

POST /v1/security/invitations/accept binds the authenticated caller to the org by the invited identity. Fail-closed: 403 IDENTITY_MISMATCH when the signed-in identity != the invited address; 410 when expired/revoked; 409 INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED (idempotent success-equivalent). On success emits identity.membership.added via the transactional outbox.

Accept->signup->bind for a brand-new external invitee: unauthenticated accept routes into the existing @fuzefront/auth-ui sign-up (Authentik enrollment) with the invite token carried through; on return the pending invite auto-accepts by verified identity. The invited email is locked in the sign-up form.

Facebook social sign-up is NET-NEW: only Google exists today (single SocialButton / data-action='social-google'; connected-accounts links Google only). Facebook needs a new provider + social endpoint; call it out, do not assume it exists.

409 LAST_OWNER invariant on ownership-affecting actions, extending authz-admin's commissioned LAST_ADMIN (owner|admin|member|viewer is the real membership_role_enum). Role set offered in the invite modal is admin|member|viewer; owner is held by the org creator and not assignable from the modal.
NEW Kafka Zod events in shared/: identity.invitation.created, identity.invitation.accepted, identity.invitation.revoked (owned by contract-designer alongside the OpenAPI).
NEW route /root/customers (root/portal customer-management surface) is commissioned by flow 3; distinct from member-directory's /organizations/:id/directory.

designSystemAdditions: SegmentedControl — token-driven 2-3 option toggle (invitee kind, channel, member type). NET-NEW to @fuzefront/design-system; named for a frontend-engineer foundation PR; drawn here from tokens only.
PhoneNumberInput — E.164 country-code + number field with validation. NET-NEW (no phone-input / libphonenumber exists in the repo today).
SocialButton (Facebook variant) — NET-NEW provider; only Google exists today. Extend @fuzefront/auth-ui's SocialButton.
StatusCallout — soft-tinted inline banner (icon + title + text + actions) for the fail-closed states. Already named by account-security; reuse the same primitive, do not re-invent.
build.packagingDecision: Primary home is @fuzefront/identity-ui (beside authz-admin, member-directory, employee-console). Only split into a dedicated @fuzefront/org-invitations-ui if the multi-channel + public accept-bind scope earns an independent lifecycle — flagged for the orchestrator, not assumed.

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker + build inventory: three flows (6 ordered screens), the component/package plan, the design-system additions, and the commissioned contract deltas.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the build inventory mirrors manifest.build 1:1 (flows, components, packages, DS additions, contract deltas); every named flow card resolves to its screen. data-approval-status='pending' until a flow is approved.

frames.label: (a) Invite modal
frames.summary: The invite dialog on the org Members tab: invitee kind (existing account-holder | external) segmented toggle, channel (email | WhatsApp) toggle with the matching address field, role radios (admin|member|viewer), member-type (employee|customer) toggle, and a live review summary before Send.
frames.acceptanceNotes: POST /v1/security/tenants/{tenantId}/invitations on Send. data-field='invitee-kind'|'channel'|'role'|'member-type' each drive one control; the selected option carries data-selected='true' and aria-pressed/aria-checked. Channel switches the address field: data-channel-field='email' shows the email input, data-channel-field='whatsapp' shows the PhoneE164Field (country code + number). The review panel (data-panel='invite-preview') reflects address + channel + role + member type live. Role options are admin|member|viewer only — owner is not assignable here. Submit (data-action='send-invite') is blocked until a valid address + role + member type are present (see 06-states for invalid-phone and send-error). No identity-vendor name in the DOM.

frames.label: (b) Pending invitations
frames.summary: The per-org pending-invitations panel above the member list: each row shows address, channel glyph, role + member-type tags, who/when/expiry, a status pill (sent/pending), and resend (rate-limited, disabled during cooldown) + revoke actions.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rows render from GET /v1/security/tenants/{tenantId}/invitations (InvitationPage). data-list='pending'; each row carries data-invitation (opaque id) and data-status. data-count='pending' shows the true count. Resend (data-action='resend') is disabled during the rate-limit cooldown (POST .../resend -> 202). Revoke (data-action='revoke') opens a confirm (RevokeInviteDialog) then DELETE .../{invitationId} -> 204. Accepted invitations drop off this list. Role/member-type tags key to the invitation record, never hard-coded.

frames.label: (c) Accept · resolve
frames.summary: The public accept landing: the resolved invitation preview (org name, role, member type, expiry, masked invited address, inviter) with a 'Create account & accept' primary and a 'sign in to accept' alternative.
frames.acceptanceNotes: GET /v1/security/invitations/resolve?token= populates data-panel='invite-summary' with org/role/member-type/expires — never trusting client state. data-value='org-name'/'role'/'member-type'/'invite-email' come from the preview. 'Create account & accept' (data-action='accept-continue') routes to sign-up carrying the token; 'sign in to accept' (data-action='accept-signin') routes to sign-in. Expired/revoked (410) and already-accepted (409) render the fail-closed cards in 06-states, not this happy path. The address is masked server-side; the token is opaque.

frames.label: (d) Sign up & bind
frames.summary: Step 1 create-account panel (Continue with Google, Continue with Facebook, or email with the invited address locked) and Step 2 the auto-bind success panel confirming org + role + member type + signed-in account.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Sign-up reuses @fuzefront/auth-ui (12+ password policy etc.); this feature only adds the invite binding. Email is readonly, locked to the invited address (data-input='signup-email') — the bind key. Social: data-action='social-google' exists today; data-action='social-facebook' is NET-NEW (commissioned). On submit (data-action='create-and-accept') the account is created then POST /v1/security/invitations/accept auto-binds — no separate accept step. The success panel (data-panel='bind-success', data-state='bound') shows data-value='org'/'role'/'member-type'/'account' from the returned Membership and a 'Go to org' CTA (data-action='go-to-org'). Fail-closed cases (403 mismatch, 410, 409) are in 06-states.

frames.label: (e) Root customer invite
frames.summary: The root/portal owner's customer-invite surface: channel (email | WhatsApp), a personal-email/e164 field, role radios (member|viewer), member type fixed to Customer, and a live review before Send.
frames.acceptanceNotes: POST /v1/security/tenants/{tenantId}/invitations with memberType='customer' forced. data-panel='root-customer-invite'. The member-type control (data-field='member-type') is fixed/disabled to Customer (aria-disabled). External email (data-input='customer-email') accepts any address — the invitee needs no existing account (they go through accept->signup->bind, flow 2). Role defaults to viewer. The review (data-panel='customer-preview') shows address + channel + role + Customer tag. Only a root/portal owner reaches this surface; a non-owner gets 403 (see 06-states forbidden).

frames.label: (f) States & fail-closed
frames.summary: Every state a consumer must render: loading (aria-busy) / empty / error+retry for the pending list; the WhatsApp channel + invalid-e164 validation + resend-cooldown variants; and the fail-closed contract — 410 expired/revoked token, 403 identity mismatch, 409 already-accepted, 409 last-owner, and 403 forbidden-to-invite.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading = aria-busy skeleton rows for in-flight GET /invitations. Empty is a real state (no pending invitations) with an invite CTA. Error shows data-action='retry'. Channel-whatsapp shows the PhoneE164Field; invalid-phone shows data-error-code='INVALID_PHONE' on a bad e164 and blocks submit. Resend-cooldown disables data-action='resend' with a countdown. Fail-closed cards each carry data-http + data-error-code: token-invalid (410, INVITATION_EXPIRED) tells the invitee to ask for a new link; identity-mismatch (403, IDENTITY_MISMATCH) names both identities and offers switch-account; already-accepted (409, INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED) is treated as success with a go-to-org CTA; last-owner (409, LAST_OWNER) refuses an ownership-orphaning action and offers transfer-ownership; forbidden (403, FORBIDDEN) is rendered IN PLACE, never a sign-in redirect (only 401 re-authenticates). send-error (DELIVERY_FAILED) keeps the invite as a draft and offers resend.
